Hangover shakes are ` [Highlight start] mild tremors—usually in the hands, fingers, arms, or head—that happen after drinking alcohol [Highlight end] ` . They typically begin as blood alcohol levels drop and last up to 24 hours, though they can occasionally stretch into a second day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXsip0aPjZNyfMVflPgsQDWuIM7ToR5Dd9CqB6LpIa_QFwDmm77GyivenS-Sm9Znww9asZ4gXH0Clk48M55zuRiC2NOqkJv2PxLVep8lxoMk1xnFGCfEvkw_vQi1vPR4yX9ovOvqkEjPolvUVytoQfPno-aL-7euPdOAw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX8yy5PFO1IOrzzwiNX2njvtl-ueb3euT6JKy3RFIofK2AL1CJ4kSkF681wM43pJjmfCNj_P0f5S7rD5aGbOXWulPws1OnrJXQeD-Qy-Wc30MUgpFWX2Uapkb5tyws4aOPhr-tKjTMS9w3YmNnJwisI5XDr2P3jL6eRw)

### Why They Happen

- **Nervous system rebound:** Alcohol alters brain chemicals like GABA (calming) and glutamate (stimulating). As alcohol wears off, the nervous system becomes temporarily overactive, triggering tremors, a racing heart, anxiety, and sweating.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX8yy5PFO1IOrzzwiNX2njvtl-ueb3euT6JKy3RFIofK2AL1CJ4kSkF681wM43pJjmfCNj_P0f5S7rD5aGbOXWulPws1OnrJXQeD-Qy-Wc30MUgpFWX2Uapkb5tyws4aOPhr-tKjTMS9w3YmNnJwisI5XDr2P3jL6eRw)
- **Low blood sugar:** Alcohol interferes with blood sugar regulation, and low blood sugar can cause shakiness and weakness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)
- **Dehydration:** Fluid loss and electrolyte shifts can worsen overall hangover discomfort and fatigue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXU86_Rrq6oQL3bUz2uaHeCIZIEacoC2MXecLkz7NiDkWvjNN92n6FoKZgYIPEsbFDlo3rxsSj4jj3i-a2Ru5AxevDUDvAOfAwFF2SAVHF6_RuLSiI-b23J3psq4XStf-A_9eZzY33dVYrsKz70A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)

### How to Manage and Daily Impact
Hangover shakes can make fine motor tasks—like holding a cup, typing, or driving—difficult or uncomfortable. Most mild cases resolve on their own with basic care:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXsip0aPjZNyfMVflPgsQDWuIM7ToR5Dd9CqB6LpIa_QFwDmm77GyivenS-Sm9Znww9asZ4gXH0Clk48M55zuRiC2NOqkJv2PxLVep8lxoMk1xnFGCfEvkw_vQi1vPR4yX9ovOvqkEjPolvUVytoQfPno-aL-7euPdOAw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX8yy5PFO1IOrzzwiNX2njvtl-ueb3euT6JKy3RFIofK2AL1CJ4kSkF681wM43pJjmfCNj_P0f5S7rD5aGbOXWulPws1OnrJXQeD-Qy-Wc30MUgpFWX2Uapkb5tyws4aOPhr-tKjTMS9w3YmNnJwisI5XDr2P3jL6eRw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)

- **Rehydrate:** Sip water or an electrolyte drink to replace lost fluids.
- **Eat bland foods:** Try toast, crackers, or broth to steady blood sugar without upsetting your stomach.
- **Rest:** Give your body time to clear alcohol and rebalance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)

For more details on how nervous system shifts trigger tremors and when to check in with a doctor, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)

### Hangover Shakes vs. Alcohol Withdrawal
Occasional mild shakes after heavy drinking differ from alcohol withdrawal tremors, which are more common with frequent or heavy alcohol use. Withdrawal symptoms often intensify over 24 to 48 hours and can carry serious risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX8yy5PFO1IOrzzwiNX2njvtl-ueb3euT6JKy3RFIofK2AL1CJ4kSkF681wM43pJjmfCNj_P0f5S7rD5aGbOXWulPws1OnrJXQeD-Qy-Wc30MUgpFWX2Uapkb5tyws4aOPhr-tKjTMS9w3YmNnJwisI5XDr2P3jL6eRw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXsip0aPjZNyfMVflPgsQDWuIM7ToR5Dd9CqB6LpIa_QFwDmm77GyivenS-Sm9Znww9asZ4gXH0Clk48M55zuRiC2NOqkJv2PxLVep8lxoMk1xnFGCfEvkw_vQi1vPR4yX9ovOvqkEjPolvUVytoQfPno-aL-7euPdOAw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXU86_Rrq6oQL3bUz2uaHeCIZIEacoC2MXecLkz7NiDkWvjNN92n6FoKZgYIPEsbFDlo3rxsSj4jj3i-a2Ru5AxevDUDvAOfAwFF2SAVHF6_RuLSiI-b23J3psq4XStf-A_9eZzY33dVYrsKz70A)

### When to Seek Medical Attention
Talk to a healthcare professional or seek urgent care if shakes:

- Last longer than 24 hours or keep getting worse.
- Happen regularly after drinking or when cutting back.
- Come with severe anxiety, confusion, hallucinations, chest pain, persistent vomiting, or seizures.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkQ3He-FRY9jNQQCHosRBeI5wfB7pGrW-w4sXeX6ehAOqDToDSbkOpPD1xJ7L7n_MJs9RQbomaswsfk3-LAEuF4rcweWBvfPMn2vUCVDhC0nUA6P9amBUWZt_Ghp39SQGmtDHhmiIY4K-UWvpfWUU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX8yy5PFO1IOrzzwiNX2njvtl-ueb3euT6JKy3RFIofK2AL1CJ4kSkF681wM43pJjmfCNj_P0f5S7rD5aGbOXWulPws1OnrJXQeD-Qy-Wc30MUgpFWX2Uapkb5tyws4aOPhr-tKjTMS9w3YmNnJwisI5XDr2P3jL6eRw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXU86_Rrq6oQL3bUz2uaHeCIZIEacoC2MXecLkz7NiDkWvjNN92n6FoKZgYIPEsbFDlo3rxsSj4jj3i-a2Ru5AxevDUDvAOfAwFF2SAVHF6_RuLSiI-b23J3psq4XStf-A_9eZzY33dVYrsKz70A)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXsip0aPjZNyfMVflPgsQDWuIM7ToR5Dd9CqB6LpIa_QFwDmm77GyivenS-Sm9Znww9asZ4gXH0Clk48M55zuRiC2NOqkJv2PxLVep8lxoMk1xnFGCfEvkw_vQi1vPR4yX9ovOvqkEjPolvUVytoQfPno-aL-7euPdOAw)
